The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century.

MicroAGI is building it. We are the data layer for physical AI.

Every customer needs data delivered in a slightly different shape. Your job is to be the last-mile delivery layer: take what the internal team has prepared, transform it into the required customer format, and make a messy process look effortless from the outside.

What You Will Do

  • Transform prepared data into the exact format each customer needs.

  • Gather and consolidate customer requirements into reusable modules, checklists, and workflows that the team can run again.

  • Sit between the internal team and the customer as the delivery layer for data outputs.

  • Coordinate fixes when something goes wrong, and communicate clearly with the customer at a lightweight Slack-level of interaction.

  • Follow the existing documented delivery process step by step, then make it easier to run over time.

  • Build internal tools that both technical and operations teams can use to make data delivery faster, clearer, and less manual.

  • Use AI tools heavily as part of the day-to-day work.

Requirements

  • Smart generalist with clear, simple algorithmic thinking. You do not need to be a deep technical specialist.

  • Obsessive attention to detail. The job is won or lost on small mistakes.

  • Fast learner. Every customer has different requirements, and you will need to adapt quickly.

  • Comfortable turning messy, complex processes into something that looks clean and reliable from the outside.

  • Comfortable with basic customer communication when something needs to be clarified or fixed.

  • High agency - you don't wait to be told what to do.

  • Fluent in English.
